column7: every WebAuthn assertion ceremony (second-factor login, step-up reauth, passwordless) that core begins through ports.WebAuthnRelyingParty stores user verification REQUIRED, so a valid assertion whose authenticator did not verify the user is refused (W3C NoneES256 vector); a mutant adapter asking "preferred" lets it in, so the test exercises the option (CORE-DECOUPLE-WEBAUTHN-1)
